    {
      "ref": "[R62]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A user reports being charged $46 to play a game advertised as free.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I don’t know if anyone else has been having the same problem but it will not let me play without paying. When I open up the game it tells me to upgrade it, when I try to upgrade it in the App Store it tells me e that I need to add a payment option. So I go to add my card info, thankfully I added the one with no money, and I looked to see that I got a $46 charge. This is unacceptable when you guys advertise the game as free."
    },
    {
